correctness.rationale: Definitions specify the word by odd parts, all positions and positive lengths, fixed binary universality, and both bounds. Odd-part arithmetic yields four eight-letter blocks, an exact 12-case scanner transfer, and a telescoping K-block formula valid for every K. The three possible endpoint regimes are finite and exhaustively checked via verify.py; their inclusive ranges prove \([-11,7]\). Explicit factors at positions [7,24) and [2,13) attain the bounds. Separate 4096-position direct checks independently corroborate but are not the infinite proof.
